tools.name: gavel_list_workflows
tools.description: List the names of all Gavel workflows on the account. API: GET /api/playground?folder=questions.

tools.name: gavel_get_workflow_variables
tools.description: Get the variable schema of one workflow: each variable name, data type, input type, label, options and whether it is required. Use it to learn what data gavel_create_session accepts. API: GET /officeaddin?pgtypes=<name>.yml.

tools.name: gavel_create_session
tools.description: WRITE: create a new session of a workflow with pre-filled variables. It does not send or sign anything. Each call creates one more session. Returns session_id and a continuation_url. If all variables are given, the URL opens the document download page; else the user answers only the missing question

tools.name: gavel_list_session_documents
tools.description: List the documents of a completed workflow session: name, format (docx or pdf), type, source template and download URL. This tool returns metadata only. The download URL needs the X-Api-Key header. API: GET /api/documate/v1/data-manager/workflows/{name}/session/{id}/documents.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gavel_list_session_documents · Private data: gavel_create_session, gavel_list_session_documents · Public sink: gavel_create_session · Destructive: gavel_list_session_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gavel_list_session_documents · Private data: gavel_create_session, gavel_list_session_documents · Public sink: gavel_create_session · Destructive: gavel_list_session_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
